2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/MARA SIRIA CAMP/Mara Siria Resident Rates & Packages 3Jan-31March26.pdf

currency.residentPackages: KES (flying packages to/from Nairobi in KES; flying packages to/from Diani/Mombasa/Malindi quoted in USD even for residents)

groundPackageRates_perPersonPerNight.includes: Full board meal plan, 2 game drives, local airstrip transfers shared with other guests

allInclusiveSupplement.includes: soft drinks, local beers, house wines

thirdAdult.raw: Sharing in extra bed pays 75% of the pp double rate

childPolicy.raw: 0-4 years FOC; below 12 years sharing with parents 50%, in own room 75% of pp double rate

policies.deposit: 30% down payment after invoice to secure reservation
policies.finalPayment: No later than 30 days prior to arrival
policies.lastMinuteBooking: Bookings 30 days or less prior to arrival must be paid in full at time of booking
policies.cancellation: 60-31 days prior: 30% of applicable rate per cancelled bed/night; 30-21 days: 50%; within 20 days or no-show: 100% of booking value

residentAndPackageRates.confidenceNote: [Unverified] This file's validity window is only Q1 2026 - do NOT apply these figures to other months without confirming a later card exists.
residentAndPackageRates.currency: KES (per person double, SRS = Single Room Supplement)

groundPackagePerNight.includes: Local airstrip transfers, 2 game drives per day or one full day drive, full board accommodation, coffee & tea

flyingPackages.includes: 1 or 2 nights full board accommodation, return flights incl. local departure taxes, airstrip transfers shared, 2 game drives (1 night) / 4 game drives (2 nights) shared

childPolicy.raw: Below 3 years FOC (room rates only); 3-11 years sharing with parents 50% of full board accommodation and 75% of package rates

residentAndPackageRates.parkFees: To be paid at the entrance gate or online, cashless only - not included in rates
